queries: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM album_stats) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM album_stats) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), scored AS (SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, diff_from_overall_avg FROM scored ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An album's bytes-per-millisecond rate is the average of each track's Bytes/Milliseconds, and tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from that rate (zero Milliseconds is treated as missing).

The all-album average is the unweighted mean of the per-album averages. The group of tracks with no AlbumId counts as one album in that mean and can appear in the results. Albums with no computable rate are left out.
Average UnitPrice is taken over all tracks in the album, including tracks with NULL Bytes. Nothing is rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: An album's rate is total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds (a weighted ratio), not the average of per-track ratios. The all-album average is the mean of those album rates. Only tracks with non-NULL Bytes count toward the rate.
alternatives.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM album_stats) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An album's bytes-per-millisecond is the average of each track's Bytes/Milliseconds. Tracks with NULL Bytes or zero Milliseconds are ignored for that rate.
The all-album average is the unweighted mean of the per-album averages. Tracks with no AlbumId form one group (NULL AlbumId) that counts as one album in this mean.
Groups whose rate is entirely missing are left out of the ranking and the overall mean. The average UnitPrice covers all tracks in the group.

alternatives.interpretation: An album's rate is its total bytes divided by its total milliseconds, using only tracks that have Bytes. The overall average is still the mean of the album rates.

assumptions.assumption: An album's 'average bytes per millisecond' is the mean of each track's Bytes/Milliseconds ratio. Tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored for this rate. They still count toward the album's average UnitPrice.
The 'all-album average' is the unweighted mean of the per-album averages, with the NULL-AlbumId group counted as one album. It is not a per-track average.
Albums whose rate is entirely missing (all Bytes NULL) are excluded. Values are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Album rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds, and the baseline is the same ratio over all tracks. Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from both sums.
alternatives.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - (SELECT SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) FROM Track) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
